reason: A parody interface plugin that overlays fictional advertisements, popups, recommendations, and themed visual interactions on the DSH web UI, with limited GitHub lookups initiated by the user.

summaries.zh: 一款为 DSH 网页界面添加虚构广告、弹窗、插件推荐和复古主题互动效果的娱乐型界面插件。
summaries.en: An entertainment-focused interface plugin that adds fictional ads, popups, plugin recommendations, and retro-themed interactive effects to the DSH web UI.

capabilities: Injects fictional advertisements and popup-style content into the DSH web interface
Changes localized visual assets, copy, and interactions based on the selected language
Displays recommendations linking to public GitHub plugin repositories
Queries GitHub Star status after explicit user activation and stores results locally in the browser
Persists per-ad display settings in the local browser
